findings.summary: We Care 4 U LLC activated its DHS HCBS license approximately 8 weeks after HADEF was involuntarily dissolved and reinstated, suggesting the operator pivoted to HCBS services following FOF-era enforcement disruption
findings.detail: HADEF was involuntarily dissolved 2025-01-07 and reinstated approximately 18 days later. We Care 4 U LLC then obtained DHS HCBS license 1114633 on 2025-03-14. The LLC had been incorporated since 2019 without a DHS license. This timeline is consistent with the operator shift strategy documented elsewhere in MN FOF-adjacent cases, though it could also represent opportunistic legitimate licensing.

findings.summary: We Care 4 U LLC shows multiple structural red flags for potential HCBS Medicaid fraud: virtual office suite shared with inactive entities, operator with FOF-adjacent history, license activated post-enforcement disruption, no NPI, no public employee roster
findings.detail: Risk factors: (1) Suite 224 is shared with Horizon Academy (inactive nonprofit, never filed 990), suggesting thin operational presence; (2) Mukhtar Yusuf controlled HADEF during its 2021 food distribution revenue spike at an FOF-purchased building; (3) License obtained March 2025, 8 weeks after HADEF dissolution/reinstatement; (4) No NPI, no Medicare billing, Medicaid-only via state DHS; (5) No public staff roster or employee background checks visible; (6) Multiple prior inactive LLCs suggest shell-building practice. None of these factors individually constitute fraud — but the pattern matches documented MN HCBS fraud profiles.
